rationale: FSM executor already routes sub-loop on_yes/on_no purely by final_state=="done" name match, so a distinctly-named unevaluated terminal needs zero executor changes; established precedent exists in oracles/code-run-gate.yaml and oracles/generator-evaluator.yaml with a matching BUG-1017 regression test. Option A (content-based evaluate: routing on a loop:-typed state) would be silently inert since _execute_sub_loop never consults state.evaluate.
rule: Option B: distinct unevaluated terminal state for rlhf-svg-evaluate sub-loop
alternatives_rejected: Option A: add evaluate:{type: output_contains, pattern: VISION_PASS} to the parent's run_evaluate sub-loop-invoking state
